record_layout: trace clone witness point xyz + parameter1
trace parameter2 + iteration count + terminal code + effective thickness
trace speed bound + reserved + reserved + reserved
native_kernel_contract.trace_policy: A diagnostic-only clone records conservative-advance iteration records. It is not production authority; compare its summary outputs bitwise to direct production outputs during the later native replay.

limitations: No Metal/GPU execution has been performed.
FP64 geometric and conservative-advance values are independent references, not formal continuous-collision certificates.
Input endpoints reproduce the source-103 FP32 FEM start expression finish - dt*velocity.
No physical transaction or accepted state is modified.
